title: DAYBREAK // KILLHOUSE — OMP
summary: An OMP-built daytime Three.js horde shooter with a rifle, shotgun and tactical movement.
description: A standalone DAYBREAK // KILLHOUSE comparison build created in OMP by Grok 4.7. It features a sunlit killhouse arena, weapon switching, aim-down-sights, enemy waves, recoil, hit effects and a recording HUD toggle.
